title: Crate Home
core_verb: Push each crate one cell at a time onto its marked goal tile.
fantasy: A quiet warehouse grid where a lone mover slides crates onto painted goal tiles.
fail_state: The 120-second timer expires before every crate sits on a goal tile.
win_state: Push every crate onto a goal tile so no goal remains uncovered.

interaction_tags.meaning: Impassable cell that blocks movement and pushing.
Painted target tile; a crate must be pushed onto each one to win.

notes: This bounded example chooses a 120-second puzzle clock as its loss rule and all crates on goals as its win. Four-way movement advances one cell per accepted move; a push needs a free cell beyond the crate. A timer is a choice for this brief, not a requirement for other puzzles.

scene.description: A top-down warehouse grid of grey floor tiles, red walls, wooden crates and painted gold goal tiles, a single mover to steer. Sparse: the walls, crates and goals are the whole puzzle.
